hooks.name: API, extract and adapter guard on save
hooks.description: When a file under src/extract/, functions/api/, or src/adapters/ is saved, or vite.config.ts itself, run the extract and adapter tests plus the dynamic static scan (SSRF guard, fixed API hosts, safe media, no secrets in functions/ or src/extract/, no Authorization in adapters, compiler purity). The matcher accepts both / and \ path separators.
